aliases.preinstallationAllocatorAliases: None: vendor methods are invoked via classManager property calls; install before any game/render classes.

reflectionScope.status: Instrumented allocator functions change identity/body/prototype reflection; no claim of unrestricted reflection equivalence.
reflectionScope.originalGameReferences: Source game modules contain no ClassManager/classManager/getNewID/getNewInstanceId references; getInstanceId references in game_util belong to the unrelated shakeNode helper.
reflectionScope.guard: Manager/constructor bindings, manager prototype and allocator own descriptors/identities are checked on every observed allocator call, trace event and finish. Source function reflection/writes outside this pinned scope must fail qualification.
reflectionScope.transientMutationLimit: Identity guards detect changes at traced events/calls and finish. A preinstallation alias that mutates a hidden counter and never makes another observed call cannot be detected without querying it; the pinned vendor/direct-source alias audit excludes such aliases in the supported source scope.
